key_impacts: Significant social, economic, and psychological damages reported
evidence_snippets: 17 January 1995, 5:46: an earthquake of Magnitude 7.9 shook the city of Kobe and adjoining areas in Hyogo prefectures of Japan.
It took more than 6,400 lives, destroyed thousands of houses and left millions of people homeless.
The social, economic and psychological damages were also profound.
missing_information: Exact list of adjoining affected areas beyond Kobe not specified
